steps.title: Start with a board and 4 pieces
steps.instruction: Join a board and 4 pieces (A, B, C, D, E), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A board and 4 pieces are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the MAMMUT children’s stool (2). Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (board, about 31 cm), B (piece, about 27 cm), C (piece, about 27 cm), D (piece, about 27 cm), E (piece, about 27 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 30 cm tall.
